slices.acceptanceStatement: After a full-cluster restart every controller recovers the same committed log and elects a leader. refactorSummary: RaftNode serializes every log mutation behind the previous one (serializeLogMutation) on both the follower AppendEntries path and the leader submit path.

stepDown keeps a running follower election timer; only leaving the leader or candidate role arms a fresh one.
